defs.meaning: n．前部，前面：指物体或空间的前部或前面。
adv．在前面：表示在前面或向前。
adj．前面的，前部的：位于前面或前部的。

examples.en: She has always been to the fore at moments of crisis.
examples.zh: 在危急时刻她总是挺身而出。

examples.en: The problem has come to the fore again in recent months.
examples.zh: 近几个月来这个问题又成为热点。

examples.en: There had been no direct damage in the fore part of the ship.
examples.zh: 没有对船的前部造成直接损坏。
